title: Simulation 3D Camera
text: 3D 仿真环境中带镜头的相机传感器模型，输入 2 路、输出 5 路；按 {Mounting location} 指定传感器安装位置；{Sensor identifier} 指定唯一传感器标识符、{Parent name} 指定父车辆名称 Scene、{Specify offset} 指定相对于安装位置的偏移、{Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)} 指定相对于安装位置的平移偏移量、{Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} 指定相对于安装位置的旋转偏移量、{Sample time} 指定采样时间、{Focal length (pixels)} 指定相机的焦距、{Optical center (pixels)} 指定相机光心、{Image size (pixels)} 指定相机生成的图像大小、{Radial distortion coefficients} 指定径向畸变系数、{Tangential distortion coefficients} 指定切向畸变系数、{Axis skew} 指定相机轴的斜切角、{Visualize field of view} 用于可视化相机视野、{Field of view range (m)} 指定可视化范围、{Output depth} 输出深度图、{Output semantic segmentation} 输出标签 ID 的语义分割图、{Output location (m) and orientation (rad)} 输出传感器的位置和方向，按实例取值。

ports.name: Rel Translation
ports.summary: 传感器相对于安装点的相对平移 (m) [0 0 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector of form [ X Y Z ]

ports.name: Rel Rotation
ports.summary: 传感器相对于安装点的相对旋转 (deg) [0 0 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector of form [ Roll Pitch Yaw ]

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: 3D 输出相机图像 m -by- n -by-3 array of RGB triplet values

ports.name: Depth
ports.summary: 对象深度，范围为 0 m 到 1000 m m -by- n array of object depths

ports.name: Labels
ports.summary: 标签标识符 m -by- n array of label identifiers

params.name: Sensor identifier
params.values: 唯一传感器标识符 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Parent name
params.values: 父车辆名称 Scene Origin (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: 传感器安装位置 Origin (default) | Front bumper | Rear bumper | Right mirror | Left mirror | Rearview mirror | Hood center | Roof center |...

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: 指定相对于安装位置的偏移 off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: 相对于安装位置的平移偏移量 [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: 相对于安装位置的旋转偏移量 [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Focal length (pixels)
params.values: 相机的焦距 [1109, 1109] (default) | 1-by-2 positive integer vector

params.name: Optical center (pixels)
params.values: 相机光心 [640, 360] (default) | 1-by-2 positive integer vector

params.name: Image size (pixels)
params.values: 相机生成的图像大小 [720, 1280] (default) | 1-by-2 positive integer vector

params.name: Radial distortion coefficients
params.values: 径向畸变系数 [0, 0] (default) | real-valued 2-element vector | real-valued 3-element vector | real-valued 6-element vector

params.name: Tangential distortion coefficients
params.values: 切向畸变系数 [0, 0] (default) | real-valued 2-element vector

params.name: Axis skew
params.values: 相机轴的斜切角 0 (default) | nonnegative real-valued scalar

params.name: Visualize field of view
params.values: 用于可视化相机视野的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Field of view range (m)
params.values: 可视化范围 61 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Output semantic segmentation
params.values: 输出标签 ID 的语义分割图 off (default) | on

params.name: Output location (m) and orientation (rad)
params.values: 输出传感器的位置和方向 off (default) | on
